evals.prompt: 画一张未来城市日落，电影感，横版
evals.expected_output: Uses the provider-neutral OpenMinis wrapper, excludes retired providers during auto-selection, saves a valid image under attachments, and returns actual dimensions and metadata.

evals.prompt: 把这张图改成赛博朋克雨夜风，人物别变
evals.expected_output: Uses edit mode with local compressed data URIs and never uploads the reference to public temporary hosting without explicit consent.

evals.prompt: 用智画创生成一张海报
evals.expected_output: Explains that WisArt is retired and does not submit a new job; directs the user to configure an active provider.

evals.prompt: 生成图时返回 502，换另一个站继续试
evals.expected_output: Treats 502 as ambiguous, checks documented job status when possible, and does not automatically submit a second paid job without user confirmation.
